en.p: As shown in the figure, let $\mathrm{H}$ be the foot of the perpendicular from point $\mathrm{A}$, a point in the first quadrant on the parabola with focus $\mathrm{F}(p,\,0)\ (p>0)$ and directrix $x=-p$, to the directrix of the parabola. Let $\mathrm{B}$ be the focus with positive $x$-coordinate of the ellipse whose two foci lie on the $x$-axis and which passes through the three points $\mathrm{F}$, $\mathrm{A}$, $\mathrm{H}$.
When the perimeter of triangle $\mathrm{AHB}$ is $p+27$ and its area is $2p+12$, let $k$ be the length of segment $\mathrm{HF}$. Find the value of $k^{2}$. [4 points]
